specifications.metric: Flare sonic tip upstream pressure threshold
specifications.basis: Sonic flare tip used when upstream pressure > 5 bar
Maximum recommended radiation for continuous exposure of personnel in appropriate clothing (API Std 521 Table 12 cited)
Higher radiation permitted for reduced exposure times (API Std 521 cited)

specifications.metric: Howden EMISSIONGUARD TR2 packing ring vent-gas reduction (cumulative company figure)
specifications.basis: Estimated cumulative reduction through packing-case vents, mainly petrochemical/natural-gas compression; equivalent to 60,500 t CO2
specifications.value: 20,173,000 Nm3 (693,144,000 scf) of gas prevented from leaking

specifications.metric: Number of flare types typically used in a urea plant
specifications.basis: Urea plants typically employ four flare types for various relief streams: ammonia, discontinuous, continuous and main

Ammonia has low flame propagation speed, low heating value and low flame temperature; exit velocity must be restricted for residence time and flame stability; tip diameter controls maximum design exit velocity
Prevents flashback into flare stack and upstream equipment where oxygen is present
specifications.value: higher than flame velocity of waste stream

specifications.metric: Liquid seal drum interaction with ammonia
specifications.basis: LSD commonly separates flare system from upstream header; often designed so all water is carried out during flaring and refilled afterwards
specifications.value: ammonia dissolves in water forming corrosive ammonia solution
